findings.title: Parent suppression hides newly lost build-source dependencies
findings.trigger: One published parent has a consumer of ignored dist/dep.js backed by tracked src/dep.ts; another deletes consumer and source. The unpublished merge modifies/restores consumer but inherits source deletion, while ignored stale output remains on the author's disk.
findings.cause: Absence of a tracked target in a parent is treated as an already-missing import without checking whether that parent's tracked source satisfies the existing compiled-output exemption.
findings.correction: Suppress only effective parent findings evaluated with the parent's travel rules, including tracked build-source support. Add source-losing merge rejection and source-preserving positive regressions.

findings.title: Repeated parent parsing causes quadratic work and a 217x historical replay slowdown
findings.trigger: An unchanged inherited parent importer contains many missing relative imports, or a normal merge has thousands of source files.
findings.cause: For each missing target the loop invokes git show and reparses all targets in the same parent file; merge scanning also spawns per-source blob reads.
findings.correction: Cache target sets and effective findings once per parent/importer and batch committed blob reads. Add deterministic process-call/cache scaling coverage and rerun historical timing.

verification.static_gates: AST syntax, bash -n, _travels.py HEAD, git diff --check all exit 0
verification.independent_controls: Cross-parent JS/TS deletion rejected; 81 inherited failures allowed; novel merge credential rejected with redacted output; remote-known credential allowed; remote-only custom-ref and nested non-commit tag accepted; hook snapshots including objects unchanged
verification.retained_reproducer: reproduce.md executed successfully; base rejects Q1, repair accepts and private push succeeds, fresh clone build/runtime fail
verification.historical_replay: Exact candidate and ordered parents, same stdin, private remotes, all fixture bytes including objects unchanged

not_reported_as_regressions: Non-commit blob/tree credentials were already allowed by the pre-story 36d3ed6 hook; no novel commit/merge credential regression reproduced.
Repeating an existing importer-target edge in resolution does not establish a novel edge under the documented contract.
